$comment: Shared fixtures for canView (docs/contracts.md §C3). Run by packages/types/test/canView.test.ts, tests/lua/canview_test.lua and /fredpd_selftest. `rules` must equal db/seed/visibility_rules_default.sql (a TS test parses the SQL). Each viewer is a complete ViewerSchema value (viewer.grants.tier/units mirror viewer.tier/units, rank null, fixed computedAt). engineCases test evaluation semantics with their own rules. unvalidatedCases (own rules) feed input the schemas reject, e.g. DB rows cast without parsing: both ports must fail closed identically.
